rationale: DeepSeek Session log, derived model surface and persistence are distinct from policy-controlled Memory. In-memory append precedes observer routing; explicit writer barriers govern durability; interrupted calls have synthetic unknown/not-started outcomes. These are lifecycle research references under B-0028/B-0034, not evidence to relabel task-local receipts as Memory or add a memory/session store.
duplicate_disposition: Existing qualified proposal owns the pressure; preserve its payload, parent and state. Source/test research only: no new B-number, approval, grant, inference or implementation.
